    "Main_Findings": [
      "The paper highlights the need for a common higher education qualifications framework in the EAC to promote regional integration and mobility.",
      "It outlines the key components and principles of such a framework.",
      "It emphasizes the importance of stakeholder collaboration and political commitment for successful implementation."
    ],
    "Challenges_Barriers": [

      "Varying quality assurance standards",

      "Stakeholders should collaborate to ensure the framework is relevant and effective.",
      "Quality assurance agencies should work together to harmonize standards.",
      "Adequate funding should be allocated to support the implementation of the framework."

      "Further research is needed to evaluate the impact of the EAC higher education qualifications framework on student mobility and regional integration."
